blocks.text: Git records project history. Start by checking the repository and local changes before switching branches or applying someone else's patch. Managed git-ssh and key-manager workflows keep authentication separate from source content.

git status --short --branch
git diff --stat
git log -5 --oneline
User Git preferences live in ~/.gitconfig; repository settings live in .git/config. Repository hooks and build scripts can execute code. Inspect unfamiliar projects before running their commands.

Preserve a separate copy of uncommitted work before destructive operations. Inspect history/reflog locally when a commit seems missing. Do not use hard reset, clean or force push without understanding which work they discard.
Diffs and repository URLs can contain credentials or private content. Review them before sharing. Never commit secrets.
